newsitem.title: QATAR: London welcomes Qatar reconciliation with ex-emir.
newsitem.headline: London welcomes Qatar reconciliation with ex-emir.

text.p: Britain welcomed the recent reconciliation between Qatar's Emir Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa al- Thani and his father, whom he had deposed in a bloodless coup last year, Britain's defence secretary said on Monday.
"Britain welcomes the understanding between His Highness the Emir and his father, the former emir," Michael Portillo told reporters at the end of a two-day visit to the Gulf Arab state.

The ousted ruler, Sheikh Khalifa bin Hamad al-Thani, is expected to return home soon following the reconciliation, which ended a bitter stand-off within the ruling family of the oil and gas-rich country on Saudi Arabia's eastern coast.

The present emir's government has accused Sheikh Khalifa, who currently lives in self-imposed exile in London, of misappropriating billions of dollars in missing funds from the treasury during his rule.
The government has now said that it will drop all legal claims filed in eight courts worldwide against the former emir in return for an assurance to settle the accounts.
